abstract: The aim of this article is to conduct an overview of the current state of knowledge about patients presenting anti-Nmethyl- D-aspartate receptor encephalitis associated with neoplastic process, as well as diagnosis and treatment. This disease concerns mainly young women and correlates with ovarian teratoma. Most important problems seems to be the difficulties in making a proper diagnosis ensuing from the rarity of this syndrome, the period from the appearance the first symptoms to starting treatment and the correct handling of intensive care complications. There are only a few articles describing severe, complicated cases of this type of encephalitis, requiring treatment in an intensive care unit.
abstract_ja: 本論文の目的は、腫瘍性疾患に関連する抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体脳炎の患者について、診断と治療を含む現状の知見を概観することである。この疾患は主に若年女性に生じ、卵巣奇形腫と関連する。最も重要な問題は、症候群の稀少性に起因する正確な診断の困難さ、最初の症状出現から治療開始までの期間、および集中治療における合併症の適切な管理である。集中治療室での治療を要する重症で複雑な症例を記載した論文は少数にとどまる。
